comment: Single source of the protocols the K5 package speaks across its two
languages. tools/gen_k5_proto.py derives from this file the Rust module
the supervisor, the work and the services use, and the C header the
language runtime, the validation tool and the inference engine use.
The K4 store protocol is not here: it is K4's, unchanged, and generated
from abi/schema/k4-store-v1.json. A port that grew a second persistence
protocol beside the first would have avoided the interesting half of the

HostOp.name: REQUEST
HostOp.doc: One Thalyx request: a verb and its arguments.

HostOp.name: VALIDATE
HostOp.doc: One validation, through the tool the whole verb uses.

HostOp.name: CHANGED
HostOp.doc: What the workspace really shows changed.

HostOp.name: MODEL
HostOp.doc: One inference from the resident engine.

HostOp.name: ASSERT_FAILED
HostOp.doc: An assertion that did not hold. The latch is on the other side of this call.

HostOp.name: FINISH
HostOp.doc: The program has finished, and this is how.

HostOp.name: NEEDS_MODEL
HostOp.doc: The program stopped and asked for a decision it would not make.

Finish.name: RETURNED
Finish.doc: It ran to the end and returned a value.

Finish.name: NEEDS_MODEL
Finish.doc: It asked for a decision a machine should not make. Not a success.

Finish.name: ASSERTION
Finish.doc: An assertion said no. Everything after it did not run.

Finish.name: THREW
Finish.doc: It threw something it did not catch.

Finish.name: REFUSED
Finish.doc: It could not be read, or the engine could not be built.

Verdict.name: NOT_PROVEN
Verdict.doc: The check could not run. Never a pass.

LaunchOp.name: RUN_TOOL
LaunchOp.doc: Run a tool over the sealed candidate lent with this message and report what it did.

LaunchOp.name: QUERY
LaunchOp.doc: What this launcher is and which tools it has images for.

LaunchOp.name: START_RUNTIME
LaunchOp.doc: Build and activate the language runtime over the shared channel, and answer at once: the caller has to be free to serve the calls it will make.

LaunchOp.name: STOP_RUNTIME
LaunchOp.doc: Stop it and retire its scope, whether or not it finished.

LaunchStatus.name: NOT_SEALED
LaunchStatus.doc: The candidate was not a sealed object, or was not lent at all.

EngineStatus.name: TOO_LONG
EngineStatus.doc: The prompt did not fit the context, and was not silently cut.

EngineStatus.name: CANCELLED
EngineStatus.doc: The work that asked was closed while this was running.

EngineStatus.name: FAILED
EngineStatus.doc: The request was read and could not be served; the answer bytes are the reason, as Thalyx's engine reports one.

Scenario.name: BASELINE
Scenario.doc: One work carries the vertical through.

Scenario.name: RIVALS
Scenario.doc: Two works over the same version, both asking the same engine, both publishing against the same generation. One is refused and starts again over the version that won.

Scenario.name: CANCEL
Scenario.doc: A work asks the engine for a long inference and its scope is closed while the engine computes for it; a second, unrelated work then uses the same engine.

structs.name: HostRequest
structs.doc: The inline half of a host call; the bytes are in the shared region.

fields.name: op
fields.doc: HostOp.

fields.name: request_len
fields.doc: Bytes the runtime wrote at the request offset.

fields.name: cookie
fields.doc: The runtime's own call counter, echoed back.

structs.name: HostReply
structs.doc: The inline half of a host call's answer.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Zero when the call was served.

fields.name: answer_len
fields.doc: Bytes the work wrote at the answer offset.

fields.name: stopped
fields.doc: Set once the machine has latched and refuses everything after.

structs.name: RunMetrics
structs.doc: What one run of the language runtime produced.

fields.name: finish
fields.doc: Finish.

fields.name: answer_bytes
fields.doc: Bytes of answers the machine handed the program.

fields.name: returned_bytes
fields.doc: Bytes the program returned. The compression's other side.

structs.name: LaunchRequest
structs.doc: Ask the launcher to run a tool over the candidate lent with this message.

fields.name: op
fields.doc: LaunchOp.

fields.name: tool_id
fields.doc: Which tool. A launcher refuses one it has no image for.

fields.name: candidate_digest
fields.doc: So a verdict can be tied to the bytes it was about.

structs.name: LaunchReply
structs.doc: What the launcher saw the tool do.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: LaunchStatus.

fields.name: exit_code
fields.doc: Zero is a pass and only zero is.

fields.name: cpu_ns
fields.doc: Nanoseconds the tool's own scope was charged.

fields.name: pages
fields.doc: Pages its scope held at its most.

fields.name: tool_id
fields.doc: The tool identity that actually ran.

fields.name: bytes_read
fields.doc: Bytes of the candidate the tool actually read, as the tool reported them.

fields.name: candidate_sum
fields.doc: A digest over those bytes, so a verdict names what it was about.

structs.name: CandidateHeader
structs.doc: The header of a sealed candidate: what a tool is given, and nothing else.

fields.name: magic
fields.doc: CANDIDATE_MAGIC_LOW.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: Names bound in this candidate.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: The run's seed, so a tool cannot precompute a verdict.

fields.name: root_digest
fields.doc: The candidate root this was assembled from.

structs.name: CandidateEntry
structs.doc: One name of a sealed candidate.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Where its bytes start, from the beginning of the object.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Bit 0: the content is a function body, not a script, and a tool has to compile it the way the runtime executes it.

structs.name: ToolReport
structs.doc: What a validation tool says about a candidate, in the region it shares.

fields.name: parsed
fields.doc: Files the tool compiled.

fields.name: bytes_read
fields.doc: Bytes of the candidate it actually read.

fields.name: candidate_sum
fields.doc: A digest over those bytes, so a verdict names what it was about.

fields.name: first_failure
fields.doc: The first check that did not hold, as the tool worded it.

structs.name: EngineRequest
structs.doc: Ask the engine for one inference.

fields.name: op
fields.doc: EngineOp.

fields.name: predict
fields.doc: Tokens to generate at most.

fields.name: prompt_len
fields.doc: Bytes of prompt in the lent buffer.

fields.name: grammar_len
fields.doc: Bytes of GBNF grammar right after the prompt in the lent buffer; zero for none. Thalyx's engine takes one per request.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: EngineStatus.

fields.name: elapsed_ns
fields.doc: How long this inference took.

fields.name: load_ns
fields.doc: How long the weights took to load. Every answer carries it, so residency is a number a caller sees.

fields.name: served
fields.doc: Inferences served since loading.

fields.name: first_token
fields.doc: The first token chosen, so two engines are comparable on a decision.

fields.name: first_margin_ppm
fields.doc: The margin that decision won by. A comparison of decisions is only meaningful when the decision was not a tie.

fields.name: token_digest
fields.doc: A digest over every token generated.

fields.name: weight_bytes
fields.doc: Bytes of weights held resident.

VERSION_SEEN.doc: The work read the published version. Value: the generation.

CONTEXT_ANSWERED.doc: The work asked for context about a name. Value: uses found.

WORKSPACE_OPEN.doc: A private workspace was opened over a version. Value: the workspace id.

WORKSPACE_WROTE.doc: A name was bound in the workspace. Value: bytes of the object.

CANDIDATE_FROZEN.doc: The workspace was frozen into a candidate. Value: entries.

CANDIDATE_SEALED.doc: A candidate was sealed into a memory object. Value: bytes.

TOOL_VERDICT.doc: A tool ran over the candidate. Value: its exit code.

TOOL_COST.doc: The tool's own accounting, as the launcher measured it. Value: ns.

VALIDATION_STAGED.doc: A validation record was staged. Value: its result.

PUBLISHED.doc: A publication succeeded. Value: the new generation.

PUBLISH_REFUSED.doc: A publication was refused. Value: the store status.

ABANDONED.doc: The work abandoned on purpose. Value: the workspace it discarded.

EVIDENCE_WRITTEN.doc: Evidence was written durably. Value: bytes.

EVIDENCE_READ.doc: Evidence was read back from a published version. Value: bytes.

WORK_DONE.doc: The work finished its script. Value: the role.

STORE_REFUSED.doc: The state service refused something. Value: the store status.

FINAL_GENERATION.doc: The published version after the work ended. Value: the generation.

CANCELLED.doc: The work was asked to stop and did. Value: where it was.

WORK_CPU.doc: The work's own scope accounting. Value: nanoseconds it was charged.

WORK_UNEXPECTED.doc: A step the work did not expect. Value: what it saw.

ROOT_PREFIX.doc: The digest of the root this work published or tried to. Value: prefix.

PROGRAM_COMPILED.doc: The runtime compiled the program. Value: bytes of source.

PROGRAM_REFUSED.doc: The runtime refused to compile the program. Value: where.

HOSTCALL.doc: The program made a hostcall. Value: the verb.

PROGRAM_FINISH.doc: The program finished. Value: the finish kind.

PROGRAM_CEILING.doc: A ceiling the runtime enforced. Value: which one.

PROGRAM_LATCHED.doc: An assertion latched. Value: the call it latched on.

PROGRAM_MEMORY.doc: The runtime's own memory ceiling, as the engine reports it. Value: bytes.

REFUSED_AFTER_LATCH.doc: A hostcall was refused after the latch. Value: the verb.

TOOL_START.doc: The tool started over a candidate. Value: bytes it was given.

TOOL_PARSED.doc: The tool parsed a file. Value: bytes.

TOOL_PARSE_FAILED.doc: The tool refused a file. Value: where the syntax error was.

TOOL_CHECK.doc: The tool ran a check. Value: which.

TOOL_CHECK_FAILED.doc: A check did not hold. Value: which.

TOOL_DONE.doc: The tool finished. Value: its exit code.

ENGINE_LOADED.doc: The engine loaded its weights. Value: nanoseconds it took.

ENGINE_WEIGHTS.doc: Bytes of weights the engine holds. Value: bytes.

ENGINE_SERVED.doc: An inference was served. Value: which one since loading.

ENGINE_TOKEN.doc: The first token of an answer. Value: the token identifier.

ENGINE_MARGIN.doc: The margin the first decision won by, in parts per million.

ENGINE_DIGEST.doc: A digest over every token of one answer.

ENGINE_BOUND.doc: The engine bound a worker to the invocation. Value: the invocation.

ENGINE_ELAPSED.doc: Nanoseconds one inference took, by the engine's own clock.

ENGINE_REFUSED.doc: The engine refused a request. Value: the status.

ENGINE_PROMPT.doc: The prompt the engine actually read, as a digest of its bytes.

ENGINE_LOAD_FAILED.doc: llama.cpp refused the weights. Value: a digest of the reason it gave.

ENGINE_CANCELLED.doc: An inference stopped because the caller's scope was closed. Value: tokens made before it stopped.

ENGINE_FAILED.doc: A request was read and could not be served. Value: a digest of the reason.

ENGINE_CONTEXT.doc: The context the engine built, in tokens.

ENGINE_EXCEPTION.doc: A C++ exception was thrown inside a request and caught by the engine. Value: a digest of what() said.

ENGINE_ARGMAX.doc: The highest raw logit of the first decision, computed before sampling, so the sampler's choice can be checked against it.

ENGINE_LOG_LINES.doc: Lines llama.cpp and ggml logged while loading. They go nowhere; the count says how many.

ENGINE_MODEL_BYTES.doc: Bytes of /bulk the engine was given, before it loaded anything.

ENGINE_MODEL_DIGEST.doc: FNV-1a over those bytes, computed by the engine, so the weights it loaded can be named from the host's copy.

LAUNCH_BUILT.doc: A tool domain was built. Value: the tool identity.

LAUNCH_RETIRED.doc: A tool domain was retired. Value: pages its scope had held.

LAUNCH_REFUSED.doc: A launch was refused. Value: the launcher status.

LAUNCH_NOT_SEALED.doc: The candidate a launch was given was not sealed. Value: its state.

TOOL_READ.doc: Bytes of the candidate the tool read, with the checks it ran and failed.

TOOL_SUM.doc: The digest the tool computed over the bytes it actually read.

WORK_RESUMED.doc: After a cut, the work asked the service what became of each request identity it may have spent. Value: identities spent, with the last outcome in bits 8 and up.

WORK_RECOVERED.doc: The version this work would have published is already published with its change in it: nothing to redo. Value: the generation.

WORK_ASKING.doc: The work is about to ask the engine for a long inference and has raised its signal to say so. Value: tokens asked for.

WORK_REBASED.doc: A publication was refused for a stale generation and the work started again over the version that won. Value: the generation it now stands on.

PROFILE_REFUSED.doc: A check the program asked for needs a tool this backend does not have, and the launcher refused it rather than answering with a weaker one. Value: the tool identity asked for.

these through the Rust module, the Linux reference and the gate read
this file, so the two sides of EXP-11's comparison are asked one
question from one source. `predict` is tokens; the sampler is greedy
(temperature zero) on both sides, the context is `context_tokens`, and

cases.name: publisher
cases.doc: The publisher's two prompts, in order.

cases.name: rival
cases.doc: The rival's two prompts, different from the publisher's so an answer given to the wrong work would be visible.

cases.name: long
prompts: hola hola hola hola hola hola
cases.doc: One inference long enough to be cancelled while it runs: about a second of generation on the emulated processor, against a closure that comes a quarter of a second in.
